projects.name: GTO Poker Engine
projects.blurb: A Rust GTO engine for preflop and postflop decisions: hand evaluation, range and equity, pot odds, and a discounted CFR preflop solver. Ships a terminal lookup for 6–9 players that returns bet sizing and the mix of call, raise, and fold.

projects.name: PrizePicks Scraper
projects.blurb: A Python pipeline for PrizePicks CS2 projections. An Apify actor does the scrape; this repo handles the API, normalization, caching, and an optional join with BallDontLie player history for exploratory scoring.

projects.name: Yahtzee
projects.blurb: A single-player desktop Yahtzee in Python with Zelle graphics. Three rolls a turn, click-to-hold dice, and a live scorecard across the 13 categories with the 35-point upper bonus at 63.
